rounds.text: Gyftr is displaying explosive top-line acceleration, evidenced by a compounded sales growth rate of 5025% over the trailing twelve months and 148% over three years [E16, E17], alongside a massive 3217% profit growth surge in the trailing twelve months [E21]. The company operates on a conservatively financed balance sheet with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.00x [E37], having successfully slashed borrowings down to Rs 1 Cr in Mar 2026 from Rs 36 Cr a year prior [E38]. Institutional confidence is actively building, demonstrated by foreign institutions increasing their stake to 5.10% and domestic institutions rising to 4.43% since December 2023 [E41, E42], culminating in a positive money flow signal [E43]. Furthermore, the business benefits from operating within the Financial Services sector, which is supported by a strong macro tailwind score of +0.83 [E76, E78]. Results are actively improving with a high results score of 79/100 and net profit up 142% year-over-year, cautioning against dismissing the setup on stale sentiment [E77]. Conceded: the valuation features a rich P/E of 64.9x [E1], a negative free cash flow of Rs -20 Cr in Mar 2026 [E35], and a promoter holding decrease of 13.5 percentage points since December 2023 [E40].
